subject: $3 to keep fighting for Southwest Washington
body:

I’m asking you to chip in $3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?] to help me defend one of the most competitive House seats in the country.
No, seriously. Just $3.
That’s not a typo.
I’m Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, and ever since I first won this seat in 2022, Republicans have been desperate to win it back.
They know this is one of the most competitive seats in the country – that’s why national election analysts just moved this race to "Toss-up."
They also know control of the House hinges on the outcome of our race.
That’s why the GOP is preparing to spend millions on this race.
But here's the thing: I've never had billionaire donors or Washington insiders powering my campaigns. I’ve had families, workers, and small business owners – folks who just want to believe in a better future.
I’m backed by working people chipping in what they can because they want someone in Congress who understands the challenges they're facing.
That's why your $3 matters.
* $3 helps us organize communities across Southwest Washington.
* $3 helps us reach independent and working-class voters who decide elections here.
* $3 helps us fight back against the flood of outside spending and attack ads that are already on the way.
And if enough people step up, even with just a few dollars, we'll have what it takes to win one of the closest races in the country.
So I'm asking: Can you chip in $3 right now to help us defend this seat and keep fighting for working families? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
Thank you for being part of this team.
— Marie

Jon

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Noting our progressive candidates’ astounding victories over long-term
Democratic incumbents Diana DeGette in Denver and Adriano Espaillat in New
York, the New York Times just laid out their list of which Democrats are
next on the chopping block.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260712.my-YpM&refcode=em20260712-38019&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=38019%2E1203867%2EvQHNZa ]Screenshot of a headline from the New York Times: "The Incumbent
Democrats at Risk of Losing to Progressive Challengers: A wave of outsider
fervor has already knocked out a number of incumbents in primary races.
Several more face spirited opposition."

Who’s at the very top of the list? Shri Thanedar of Michigan and Wesley
Bell of Missouri.

These two Do-Nothing Democratic incumbents are most at risk of losing
their seats to primary challengers — our very own Donavan McKinney and
Cori Bush — on August 4th.

Both Shri and Wesley are backed by AIPAC and their network of right-wing
megadonors and shell PACs, along with corporate PACs and lobby groups like
Big Tech and Big Pharma. They’re already flooding these races with
hundreds of thousands of dollars in ads and misinformation.

But they tried the same playbook in Denver and New York last month, and we
overpowered them through the power of grassroots organizing and
small-dollar donations from everyday people like YOU.

Our progressive movement’s momentum right now is undeniable. This year,
voters are showing they’re ready to replace out-of-touch career
politicians with progressive fighters who will actually put working people
ahead of powerful interests.

Now, we need to fight like hell over these final three weeks to unseat two
more establishment incumbents and send Donavan and Cori to join the rest
of our slate in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260712.my-YpM&refcode=em20260712-38019&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=38019%2E1203867%2EvQHNZa ]Let’s show everyone that our movement isn’t finished: donate

elect two more Justice Democrats!

body:
Simply put: This decision will swing more seats in the short term than the controversial mid-decade redistricting efforts that ate up so much media attention over the last year. We're watching in real-time as an entire political movement chooses the pursuit of absolute power over the fundamental rights of the people.
Please, RUSH $35 or more right now to provide the resources we need to fight for everything the Voting Rights Act stood for >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=071226_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
CNN: Efforts to game the 2026 election intensify as Republicans draw new maps [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=071226_3&amount=25]
The immediate impact shows how partisan the Louisiana v. Callais case before the Supreme Court was, Team.
In the weeks since this decision, five states have already moved to redraw their maps , dilute the impact of minority voters, and return parts of the country to a suppressive era we thought we left behind sixty years ago. Louisiana itself stopped an election with voting already in progress , and other states are moving to change their own maps soon.
CNN says this has created " an unprecedented amount of flux in American democracy six months before Election Day ." Candidates don’t know where to run. Lawmakers are seeing their districts carved up. Voters don’t know which district they live in.
This is all about power. Whether districts are fair or everyone is represented has been tossed by the wayside for MAGA's desperate grasp to control a country that's more disillusioned with their actions by the day.

Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process , is going to take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters.
Long before the MAGA movement, Chief Justice Roberts saw the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. President Trump followed this decision with a directive for conservative-led states to erase multiple majority-Black districts across the South. His supporters are climbing over one another to comply.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.
The answer is to beat them at the ballot box and elect candidates who support our fundamental right to vote. Will you chip in with $35 or whatever you can to help us fight back against their desperate ploy to hold power? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=071226_3&amount=35]

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

name: Adam Kinzinger
subject: I was there on January 6th
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117096?t=6&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD) Team,

I was there on January 6th, 2021.

I was inside the Capitol when the mob broke through. I heard the shouting in the hallways. I watched my colleagues scramble for safety.

When it was over, when the glass had been swept up and the blood had been scrubbed off the marble floors, I went back to the House floor and voted to certify the 2020 election.

And then, a few weeks later, I voted to impeach Donald Trump.

I did both of those things because I believed the truth mattered. Because I believed that what happened that day was not a protest, not a tourist visit, not a false flag: it was an attempt to overturn a free and fair election, and the people responsible needed to be held accountable.

I'm telling you all of this because I'm launching something new to fight back against Donald Trump and his attacks on our democracy, and I need you with me.

[I’m launching Back the Bold because I believe in electing Democrats who aren’t afraid to be bold and fight back against Trump. If you believe this country is worth fighting for, then I'm asking you to split $7 right away between Back the Bold and Voter Protection Project to help us hit our 10,000 Founding Donor goal »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117096?t=7&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Back the Bold PAC and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117097?t=8&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117098?t=9&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117099?t=10&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117100?t=11&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117101?t=12&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
The insurrection was five years ago.

But, team, I have spent every day and every year since watching this country get gaslit.

Watching the people who stormed those halls get pardoned and even _hired_ by Trump. Watching the officials who planned and enabled it get rewarded. Watching a man who incited a mob against his own government run for president again and win.

And I’ve questioned how we fix this broken system, how we fix our democracy, how we fight back against Trump’s blatant abuses of power.

**The best way I can think of fixing this is by electing politicians who refuse to look the other way. Period.**

That's why I'm launching Back the Bold.

We're supporting candidates who dare to stand up to MAGA extremism and hold politicians in Washington accountable. **Candidates who will say what needs to be said, do what needs to be done, and put country before politics.**

Because here's the hard truth: the only thing that stops this from happening again is a country that has a memory, and a spine, and leaders in Congress willing to use both.

We can be that country. But we have to elect people who will fight for it.
[Your donation will help us elect bold candidates who will fight back against Donald Trump. Will you split $7 today between Voter Protection Project and Back the Bold to help us hit our 10,000 Founding Donor goal? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117096?t=13&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Back the Bold PAC and VPP will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117097?t=14&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117098?t=15&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117099?t=16&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117100?t=17&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/117101?t=18&akid=26219%2E878179%2E0S5VgD)
This is not about relitigating the past.

It's about making sure the past doesn't become the future.

Thank you,

Adam Kinzinger

I need YOUR help...The next 30 days are our chance to shape the future of South Alabama.

| | | | | | | [VIEW THIS EMAIL IN BROWSER](https://mailchi.mp/e8ddc23333b1/to-my-dad-on-fathers-day-2375645?e=3cb50a0604)

# Help us fund signs, ads, and voter outreach
# before the August 11 special primary.
---
| |
Dear Friend,
We have just 30 days left before the special primary on August 11.
That means only 30 days to reach voters across South Alabama.
Only 30 days to place signs, knock on doors, make phone calls, run ads, and tell people why this election matters.
There is no time to waste.
Today, I am asking 100 people to give $30.
Not next week.
Not someday.
**Today.**
GIVE $30 TODAY:[**https://secure.anedot.com/austin-sidwell-for-congress/donate**](https://us.list-manage.com/xIuIHnyPCcd?e=3cb50a0604&c2id=afb95f668b6ac35c1d93c48700b43452)
Your $30 will help us:• Print and place campaign signs• Run ads that reach new voters• Make calls and contact families in Alabama’s 1st Congressional District• Remind voters to show up on August 11
The political establishment may have money, influence, and powerful endorsements.
I have support from people like **YOU.**
This campaign will not be won by Washington insiders. It will be won by people across South Alabama who are ready for something different.We cannot keep sending the same people to Washington and expecting different results.
We have one chance to change that.
Will you be one of the 100 people who gives $30 today?
Every sign matters.Every ad matters.Every voter we reach matters.And every donation moves us one step closer to victory.
Thirty days.
Let’s make every one of them count.
Austin Sidwell
---
| [YES, I WILL GIVE $30 TODAY](https://us.list-manage.com/NICxQKIsI66?e=3cb50a0604&c2id=afb95f668b6ac35c1d93c48700b43452)

# About Austin Sidwell
---
| |
Austin Sidwell is a husband, father, Air Force veteran, small business leader, and conservative Republican from Alabama’s Gulf Coast. A former rescue helicopter pilot and instructor, Austin now serves as Vice President of Sidwell Protection Services and is running for Congress to bring practical leadership, fiscal discipline, and a new generation of conservative service to Washington.

| | | | | | | | | | | | **Sidwell for Congress**

**Join the Movement.****Stand Up for Alabama.** Alabama’s First Congressional District is rooted in faith, family, and country, a legacy of conservative leadership that has stood firm when it mattered most. With new lines stretching from Mobile Bay to Dothan and the Wiregrass, that calling is more important than ever. Washington is full of talkers and career politicians who’ve forgotten which side they’re on. The people of South Alabama deserve someone who will fight every single day to protect our values and put America First.

| Untitled Document
There's an indigenous group of people called the Kuna in Panama that are a fascinating story in longevity as well as stellar cardiovascular health, and lack of metabolic diseases like Diabetes, etc.

The Kuna people drink an average of 5 cups of a type of cocoa every day and they have 9x lower rates of cardiovascular problems than the rest of the world.

High blood pressure is also almost non-existent in these people, yet they actually consume a good amount of salt.

And cancer rates are an astonishing 15x lower than the rest of the world. And they don't eat much leafy green vegetables either like most Americans try to stuff down.

They also consume a fair amount of sugar, yet their arteries are clean as a whistle, and blood sugar and blood pressure are normal and healthy.

But researchers found that it's NOT their genetics, because members who moved to cities and started eating modern processed foods suffered all the same health problems as most of the world (Diabetes, obesity, heart disease, etc).

In today's article, you'll find out the Kuna's longevity secrets, and what exact type of cocoa they drink that could be a huge part of their incredible health...

> [The Kuna drink 5 cups of a type of a cacao drink daily](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MzZ9AAwAAAAAAbYwMg1Y8dNuLXuOwLqvjZ8MRHvdCgANmKjSBe8JyKiMpbY3KjTgO1TauL5lj3fsVwtti4hNQXjEx0LEIvJIVm7fqkqx5djYdpDI4Hf2) (and they have clean arteries, 9x lower heart disease rates, and healthy blood pressure and blood sugar)

This type of cacao they drink has also been shown to have up to 63x the antioxidant levels of broccoli and kale.

These particular flavanols (a type of polyphenol) in this type of cacao are shown in studies to improve heart health, lower blood pressure, boost blood flow throughout the body, improve blood sugar, and even improve your gut health by diversifying your microbiome.

Even more exciting is that the article will show you a study where cacao drinkers had nearly DOUBLE the levels of GLP-1 in their body within 2 hours of drinking cacao than people that didn't drink the cacao.

And as you know, GLP-1 in your body can help you slim down faster, so this is also a really cool benefit of drinking cacao, but strength and polyphenol levels matter as you'll see below...

[Read this article to see the type of cacao](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5MzZ9AAwAAAAAAbYwMg1ZHUUSD2FFREjvHmfkV1mZXnX7kmlwugfA-rLXuzcKxHlS_pjpDxzsrwpkZdkd9vWnT_4RYTW274rq46pIvnXXCNbiSOvbZoTk) that has all of these powerful benefits. Hint: It's NOT your average grocery store cocoa.

|
Peter,
The Department of Justice just sent letters to election officials in all 50 states with a chilling threat--If a non-citizen votes, you will be personally prosecuted.
The letter also insists that state officials respond within five days to inform the justice department how it will ensure compliance "with federal laws." To avoid potential criminal charges, the DOJ "encourages" officials to contact them to "discuss steps your state should take to maintain clean voter lists as required by law."
If you've been following our work, you know that we've been sounding the alarm about the Trump admin's attempt to seize voter data. Voter data that includes sensitive information such as name, address, and party registration.
The Trump admin has been using this voter data to purge voter rolls using the "SAVE" database. A database a judge ruled was illegal because of major violations of Americans' privacy rights. And one that has been proven in court to wrongfully purge Democrats from voter rolls.
This letter isn't subtle. It's a blatant attempt to intimidate election officials into turning over your sensitive voter data.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001k-QeksNiXIzoVEtVQhBVcpE0jPdlTbXVngZApwP7fbc2e3rH4lkyIKRv0OvkQsAP7xu4DU3YqZtCpxbCoY-zN8c39WqYJT0yzb-GHSyJ5X-vtyPZK0hKWTIkxgR6JO3_Rv1-hBt2qQYon88ShibsPaIke3-L7c-yvSSMVsb2rXnXHr9XF_agY0m19lzjGHeElCTm_zRlcRuacmhzzqO9m_afWPBTlzL1gTziJ2Awzo0=&c=OtK3lX4_HiciQCjviso_MC-R9dPR2jJnyufuL7Bi72mvl8FjfyT7RQ==&ch=p7_dsg-4N4wvZRa1gzgC9aEAcI_rXjgwlvrR9qgLENXF0PYItP-zYg==)

It's yet another desperate attempt by Trump to rig the upcoming midterm elections by exerting control over how states administer elections.
The constitution is clear. States have control over how elections are administered in each respective state, not the federal government. The federal government cannot unilaterally purge voting rolls. They need states to comply with their demands. And that poses the most significant roadblock to Trump's most insidious plots to rig upcoming elections.
This is why Defend Our Courts exists. We've been leading the fight to secure Democratic majorities on state Supreme Courts across the country. The courts that will have ultimate say over election laws in respective states--a firewall against Trump's election rigging attempts.
In the past year, we helped defend the majorities on the Pennsylvania and Wisconsin state supreme courts, establishing critical firewalls in crucial swing states. In November, there are more state courts on the ballot, and we intend to bring our winning formula to those races--Nevada, Kentucky, Montana, Michigan, Minnesota.

clean_body: It’s yet another desperate attempt by Trump to rig the upcoming midterm elections by exerting control over how states administer elections. | | | | | == | Peter, The Department of Justice just sent letters to election officials in all 50 states with a chilling threat--If a non-citizen votes, you will be personally prosecuted. The letter also insists that state officials respond within five days to inform the justice department how it will ensure compliance "with federal laws." To avoid potential criminal charges, the DOJ "encourages" officials to contact them to "discuss steps your state should take to maintain clean voter lists as required by law." If you've been following our work, you know that we've been sounding the alarm about the Trump admin's attempt to seize voter data. Voter data that includes sensitive information such as name, address, and party registration. The Trump admin has been using this voter data to purge voter rolls using the "SAVE" database. A database a judge ruled was illegal because of major violations of Americans' privacy rights. And one that has been proven in court to wrongfully purge Democrats from voter rolls. This letter isn't subtle. It's a blatant attempt to intimidate election officials into turning over your sensitive voter data. | == It's yet another desperate attempt by Trump to rig the upcoming midterm elections by exerting control over how states administer elections. The constitution is clear. States have control over how elections are administered in each respective state, not the federal government. The federal government cannot unilaterally purge voting rolls. They need states to comply with their demands. And that poses the most significant roadblock to Trump's most insidious plots to rig upcoming elections. This is why Defend Our Courts exists. We've been leading the fight to secure Democratic majorities on state Supreme Courts across the country. The courts that will have ultimate say over election laws in respective states--a firewall against Trump's election rigging attempts. In the past year, we helped defend the majorities on the Pennsylvania and Wisconsin state supreme courts, establishing critical firewalls in crucial swing states. In November, there are more state courts on the ballot, and we intend to bring our winning formula to those races--Nevada, Kentucky, Montana, Michigan, Minnesota. Folks - tonight, I got multiple calls from a number I didn't recognize, right around midnight. I didn't answer.

He left voicemails instead - and here's one of them.

Before you watch this, know that **yes, this has been reported to law enforcement.** A threat of murder against a federal candidate is no joke.

I'm ok. But this is unacceptable.

## Sen. Lindsey Graham Dies at 71
South Carolina Sen. Lindsey Graham [died Saturday night](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u7CAQBeCnwR0WP74etqC4jbtNm9LCMKwnwngFZC2_feQkb5BupNHM0Xfe7_PdUaL8eHMb2hb3OeNRE7aGZU6UQ8XzUdzqtkBYK-WMpR6zEmrkArjUc3CUznnogo2ICnWHVoLRNw1qgG614J1fzBjwnzbofHQetAcZBHoD8iY7stc3AVJLIUANvZF-xMUogBDNEJENAgO1vfQfO-W2Ykzn_sLS-33rkl1be1am_zM1MTUdx9H7pV6Ka8_UdI1MTRWza3vhvyj-o-IXi7vYsPClEEbucuD1MwTMnFLKWK_jrtjwPCglqiOwQTw2R-k7v_2ptJdVXwEAAP__g3CD8A) at 71 after what his office called a "brief and sudden illness." His top aide said there was no indication he felt unwell in his final days. The D.C. medical examiner preliminarily found he died of an [aortic dissection](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAQRZ_GdIP8w2J_hYs0dJs2JTJ4vExkbGR7l_D2EUneIN1II91zz_3xnJ-OIqXXd7ejbSHPCc8asTUsc6TkK16v4ja3e8JaKSUs9ZwllyNwDULN3lG85qHzNiBKVB1aoY36UloOutusf4QghtGYx2Pkq_I8rGF0ahF-NF_Gi47snca1UIJzLYfeiHXExUitfTBDQDZw9NRy6X9mSm3DEK_8wdKvee-i3Vo7KlPfmJyYnM7z7JdcW073m8np9mFyOnKkRut93jgmJ66ZnIRkcnpXqJjgny789YXNVfCEHlxoWMDBUggDuOThnfDXgWtDDxRjwlphowo5BFoRqrtuTFesP06Kkeqo2cBfu6P4p3P7r6E_Vv4OAAD__zXykzg), a rupture of the aorta, after medics responded to his Capitol Hill home for chest pains. Graham had just returned from Kyiv, where he [met with](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu9CAMwPGnSTYiYkggA8O3ZLtv7RhBMBdXhJyAXnRvX6Xt0L2bpb9k-ee323KzFCnd_9sdTQ3HkvAsEWvFvERKvuDrnu1md09YCqWEuZwLcBgZV6wXi7cUX4tsvQmIgKJF0ystJqFAqnYz_aDcOoUJRrBS2AGC1mgDTk47x4NsyVzbuOpFz7kC2el-HdFpUMoHLQM2kqOneuTu_aBUNwzxdTwxd-uxt9FstT5KI_41MDcwn-fZJbdeiqs3MD-OSJXW8mtkV25gLpjYD5J9K9nFZKpnLhMGVj68x8QoxoSlsLwmOwygANps_OOkGKmMqpH8vluKXwfVP33xaeAzAAD__669iNU) Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to push his signature Russia sanctions bill, and was booked for his 64th appearance on _Meet the Press_. President [Trump called him](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2u4yAUxfHVQJeIr3BxQTHSyF2mGmlKi5hLfEcYLCCJsvunvC289hzpV_z_XZdroEzl_ifs6EeqS8FXzzgGtiVTiR3f9xa2sEfC3qkUbP21KKHsScBJ6iUGyu_F8OgTokLN0UtwetKgDPDNr8qBwElFGwFAoktJSDDrzSW9aps4-Y8mQGopBChzdnK1eHMKICZnEjIjMNKo7fy_UhkbpvyuT2znte48-22MozP9i6mZqXm0x9h6XSnkz_8ZjWgY8u9aQo5_22M_mJqP2kdnapbSTuICk9NG2oux1vDm4_GinKlbYEbc90DfFB8_6vP06isAAP__vOF39w) "one of the greatest people and Senators I have ever known" and a "true American Patriot." Tributes poured in from both parties as a scramble began over filling his seat. Trump hinted he already has a favorite.
## US Hits Iran Again as Strait Fight Grows
The U.S. military [struck Iran again](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDtuwzAQRE8jdTT4kbVUwSKNO6dNKazIpbUJRRkkbcO3D5QrpBwMMJj3vq7zFTlxvn3iRq7Ffc70qolaozInzqHS-1ZwxS0w1co5U6mvWUs9CglCmTkgp_c89MFFIk2mJ6fAmsmAHqBf3SRlDGSn4KMxZ6nHEAPBEkGO8RwV9eyONQnKKClBDyer_EiL1QAh2iFSN0gK3PZy-t45t5Vieu9PKie_b31ya2v32pmPTl86fcH7AXBURyiNfaJOX7hgFo-K4pG5URBYcBG0ccFGVWBr6H-EhHEICrycDEi0_uyjIqsmQGvB4tIXF-4vTonrCN0gbxty-nvR_qXu6fRvAAAA___hXIKA) overnight into early this morning, its fourth round in a week, as the standoff over the Strait of Hormuz threatens to collapse peace negotiations. Sunday's strikes hit about [140 targets](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DtuxCAUQNHV4M4WvwFcUKRxN2lTWgQ_7JfwsYCMNVl9lGwhG7hXOm_39e4wYt5fXQLbQ1kzXC1C71DXiHlr8NyrO1zaEFrDnKG2a-WUq5HqkYl1cxifqxw2GwA4iAEs00bMQnOph8Mar5RhAO7GpaI80CCZN14xo-YZjB7Q_taoZoJRqrmcDPMK3g3XegtGBiCSwoa91OmjYO4HhPgsD6iTL2mI9uj9bES8EL4QvlzXNdUANU6l7oQvjvDFQ-6-pBGry2PrFT-hjUep6et7bAeeJ-Z9xLp7whchDGWzvE1HT3GodjsvjBGb0kTSPTmMf9v-L6uH5T8BAAD___fWffQ) after Iran set a container ship ablaze, leaving an Indian crew member missing. _"We bombed the hell out of them last night,"_ President Trump said. Iran retaliated with [missiles and drones](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1u4zAQhU8jdTT4t6ZcsNjGXbbdUhibQ2tiisxyJiF8-4VyhZTvB-8B39-39Q2oUH38gR2j5LZWHFxQBPtaqCbG16PDBnsiZKZasfNYrbZnpYMybk1A5bX6OcWMaNHNGE1Y3MUF68O8RWt9umuHN2eMA5_94nG5mPALzNldbnameKzpYJzROlh_Wsz9jLfFhpDy4jNOXmMiaf303qjKhrm82hf2073tc4mbyAdP7vdkr5O9jjFOQjtyy8QdsBytyV6pQ1UgAvcnq_fWE1T1_BxAotp-RDWpfyDQ1SDZVOqtIn-7OzFTOUQW7OqTFUunJ_Jkr3OP6WNQKcTnMHn92IG-H2f5EcyvaP8HAAD__1WjjEk) at five countries hosting U.S. forces (Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Jordan, and Oman), wounding three people in Qatar, including a child. Tehran insists the strait [stays closed](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO3CAUBODT4A4LHsR4C4o07v60KS1sHvZLMKwAr-OcPtq9QtoZ6dNofn7NX44ipe2HO9C2kOeEV43YGpY5UvIV76243R2esFZKCUu9ZhAwcGG4VLN3FO9Zd94GREDVoZVmVA9lQJtut-sSlnFYHlo5WB4wqm9gjJQDAGDQq-_IvjVhpJJCGND9KNcBlxGM8WHUAZkW6Knl0v_KlNqOId75haVf89FFu7f2rEx9ZzAxmK7r6t0fyvXdMpjeNoNJGAaTlAwmKi7x2gr9xspXV7bM605PTp_UUeM58D2X4_zLPYab0sbPys_Y6HDtPLpi_fOiGKkOhmmxHY7iZ0r7r_9eFv4FAAD__8ozhSw) until calm returns. Washington says ships are still moving. Mediators are still working to save the interim deal, now at its halfway point.
## See the Declaration's Messy First Draft
Thomas Jefferson's handwritten first draft of the Declaration of Independence, complete with edits from Benjamin Franklin and John Adams, is [on display](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAUhE9jOiP_CbOFizR0mzYlMrxneJGxV7a1hNtH5ArpRprRaOb7es5PT5HS9ukPdC3kOeFZI7aGZY6UoOK1Fb_7AwhrpZSw1HNWQg1cWC71DJ7iNZsOXEBUqDt00o76oa0yttsdPvQIQkuvg4YFpPWDGZRVI2AYpTcdubtNWKmlEFaZfpTrgMuorIUwmoDMCARqufTfmVLbMcQrv7H0az666PbWXpXpD6YmpqbzPPt1qfeL22dquiVTU6Sl-HLxHPia01awVo4_Oy3UePEFORQfGgdcoy--UU53lBLgCxNgWpGpqSsOXifFSHWwzIjt8BT_drR_wXs79RsAAP___AOGbA) at the Library of Congress for America's 250th birthday. The margins changed history. Jefferson first wrote that rights were "sacred and undeniable" before Franklin suggested "self-evident," and the founders swapped "subjects" for "citizens." The draft anchors more than 120 treasures, including Abraham Lincoln's handwritten Gettysburg Address and a [541⁄2-foot petition](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO6yAQgOHT4M4WjImxC4rX0OW1W1oYxvasxhABSpTbr7JX2Av8n_R_3de7J6Z0_PcX2rbnNeGrMraGZWVKseL7KP70VySslVLCUl8rSJh6aXo1rtETv1fdRbsjAo4dWmXmcRkNaNOdNkQ1TUHDtkFc9IJjmEAp9LDcTDT71pH91KRRo5LSgB5mFSbcZjAm7rPeUWiJkVouw3em1E7c-Z2fWIaQr47t2dqjivGfACfAbZyPOnAOw5GfAhznIMB9BAFOGgHOw0327cQ-YmBffKOcav8o-aKKAlxXbHy8iJnqZISWx-WJf632p0FPCz8BAAD__yh8eM4) from 3,000 South Carolinians demanding voting rights after the Civil War. Even [Kermit the Frog](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-S2yAQxp8GdXhgQUYuKFLE3aVNqVnDStoMAg1wdpSnz9x1SXvt92_m-_18m9-QE-f1B-7k-1LmTK-WqHeqc-IcG51rxQ33yNQa50y1vWZQcJXKSW3miJzO2Q7RL0RAZiCv3WRuxoF1w-bB2hDGh9aLhgUfN7DWkNNhuo7GhIcb2H-sKaeNVsqBvUw6XOkxgXNxmexCwiqK3Eu9_Cqc-0ZLOsuT6iWUfUh-6_1ownwTcBdwx0S_McfKmPjJed1xxT-c6SMs4P5-hLJzXiU9Kff22Rm_g4BxUgLG29Q3kpFCwoqdS_7XvTV51LJzo_902YssB2XJWfZK2N4rNbliSlRPiV0KuA_Vx-PFKXG7OmHVuiOnzw_9S-CfHv4GAAD__9DNlT4) makes an appearance via Jim Henson's copyright files. Admission is free, and the exhibit runs through July 2027.

Hello, I hope your summer has been going great! Stay cool and hydrated out there.
There's a chance you've seen an ad for a reality TV show that I'm in. What's the story?
A number of months ago, I got a call that surprised me: "Hey, you've been asked to appear on a new reality TV show called 'Nation's Dumbest.' It's a fun game show like 'Are you Smarter Than a 5th Grader?' What do you think?"
I was surprised on a bunch of levels. I don't think of myself as a celebrity in the reality TV sense. I also don't think of myself as dumb. It seemed like a sharp departure from my usual activities.
But I figured it was worth a listen. I had a call with the producers during which I asked them the basic question: "Why me?"
They responded, "We are looking for a politician or journalist that people don't hate." That was kind of flattering. "It's meant to be a wholesome program for the whole family. We think you'd be great for this."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8e37a6cc-9ed1-4b66-8b01-8ff4c41806b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I got advice from different people. Some were very against me doing the show, saying it would be bad for my public image and future prospects:
"You on a billboard with the word 'Dumb' on it is not what you want."
"You're on the rise. Don't lump yourself in with a bunch of has-beens."
"You're a serious figure. Reality TV isn't serious."
But I found myself warm to the opportunity for a number of reasons.
First, it was a new experience. You only live once. When would I have the chance to do something like this again? Maybe never.
Second, I figured I'd make some new friends and connections. I was told the names of a few other figures on the show, some of whom I've been a fan of from afar for years. These included Ice-T, Anthony Michael Hall, Carmen Electra and [others](https://substack.com/redirect/6e9f5c05-8e5b-4a2a-86ab-eaaf7d167c5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It might be fun to be stuck on set with them and bond.
Third, it seemed like an opportunity to show my personality in front of a broad public audience. I do media and podcast interviews all of the time, some of which might be seen by only a few thousand people. This was a chance to get in front of millions of Americans in primetime, even if the context was a bit unusual. Maybe that would lead to more people following me and my work.
Fourth, it paid money. It was a handsome fee based on the time commitment. I agreed with Evelyn that I would donate a portion of the proceeds to an autism organization that we are involved with.
Finally, I decided to do it. I'm not someone to shy away from challenges, and it seemed like a new adventure that might lead someplace positive.
And so, I wound up a contestant on Nation's Dumbest, coming to you on Fox this Wednesday at 9 pm EST.
So . . . how did it go? What was the experience like? Did I make the right decision?
You might have to tune in to find out, as I'm kind of prohibited from sharing TOO much. But most of my reasoning was borne out; I made some new friends and definitely had a very distinct experience I won't soon forget. It could be that running for President and being on a reality TV show have more in common than you might think.
I discuss my going on "Nation's Dumbest" on the [podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/aad52e41-8e42-4666-8520-476b5f195288?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with Zach this week. body:
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. [To unsubscribe from this email list, please click here.](https://act.haleyformi.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP)

[](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/24277?t=2&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP)
Hi null, it’s Gary Peters.
I’m a fifth-generation Michigander, former U.S. Navy Reservist, U.S Senator, and fighter for Michigan families – and today **I’m asking you to join me in supporting Haley Stevens for U.S. Senate.** The stakes have never been higher, null.
As the Senator who’s represented Michigan for the past 12 years, I want to share why I know Haley is the most qualified candidate to replace me in November.

**Haley loves Michigan more than anything.** She was born and raised right here in Michigan by small business owners. Raised on the value of hard work and around a lot of grease, grime, and heavy machinery. She’s a fighter and someone who will always put Michigan families first.
But experience matters: **Haley has a record of fighting and delivering for Michiganders** – from helping save 200,000 Michigan jobs on President Obama’s auto rescue task force to passing the CHIPS and Science Act to bring _even more_ jobs to Michiganders. She was even recognized as the most effective Michigan Democrat in Congress – just like I was in the Senate. She has a strong record of getting stuff done and working across the aisle to do it.
Haley will be the fighter that Michiganders deserve, and I’m proud to support her in this race.

**null, this is one of the most important races this cycle –**** _if not the MOST important._ The GOP is already flooding the state with MAGA cash to flip Michigan red and keep control of the Senate. Haley has a tough fight ahead of her. It’s never been more critical to win this race and to put an end to Trump’s dangerous agenda.**
[**So please, will you chip in $5 to Haley’s campaign to help keep Michigan blue, send MAGA Mike Rogers packing (again) and help flip the Senate for Democrats?**](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/24283?amount=5&t=3&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP)
| | [Donate](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/24278?t=4&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP)
---
Thank you,

Gary Peters
|
* * *
**A note from Haley Stevens:** null, I’m proud to be a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. That’s why I’ve fought so hard for working families my entire life. Now, I’m running for Michigan’s open Senate seat to continue fighting for the people and communities I love. The path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan, which means this race is shaping up to be the most competitive and expensive in the entire country. The GOP is already coming after me as a top target for defeat, so I’m counting on your grassroots support to fight back and win. [**If you’re in this fight with me, will you add your name to endorse my campaign?**](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/24280?t=5&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP) | | | [](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/24279?t=6&akid=3509%2E49239%2EzjltHP)

Thank you,
Haley
